annotations.title: Encoding toolbox: Base64, hex, URL, HTML and Unicode

description: Every common encoding of one text in a single call: Base64 and Base64url, hex, URL component and full-URL encoding, HTML-escaped, ROT13, Unicode code points, UTF-8 byte count and Punycode for international domain names, plus automatic decoding when the input already looks like Base64, hex, URL or HTML encoding. Use to prepare data for headers, URLs and markup, or to work out what an encoded string says. Example: text=Café & <tags>. Price $0.02/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
